info.title: Tank: fill, overflow and run dry
info.description: A tank of 100 litres that starts with 20, a pump that delivers 6 litres a minute for 40 minutes and then stops, and a constant demand of 2 litres a minute. Nothing is random and no time step is involved: the level moves in straight lines and the engine computes the instants it reaches a bound. Read the Tank's row: it is full from minute 20 to 40 (80 litres spilled), empty from minute 90 (20 litres of demand unmet), and holds 57 litres on average over the 100 minutes.
info.notes: By hand: the level rises by 4 a minute from 20 and reaches 100 at minute 20; the pump's surplus of 4 a minute spills for 20 minutes; from minute 40 the level falls by 2 a minute and reaches 0 at minute 90. Area under the level: 1200 + 2000 + 2500 = 5700 litre-minutes, so the average is 57.
